thought.text: Let me check why the cms dev server exited and retest the backend health:

reasoning_content:
Two things to check:
1. The CMS dev server terminated again (code=0) — probably another Vite stdin-EOF issue, or it crashed. Let me look at the cms log.
2. The backend health via /health returned an empty result — let me retest.

First, let me check the cms log.

action.command:
tail -10 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/cms.log; echo "=== oom? ==="; dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -i "killed process" | tail -2
echo "=== backend health ==="
docker exec urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 sh -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8081; printf "GET /health HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Connection: close

" >&3; sleep 1; cat <&3' 2>/dev/null | head -20 | tail -3

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "tail -10 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/cms.log; echo \"=== oom? ===\"; dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -i \"killed process\" | tail -2\necho \"=== backend health ===\"\ndocker exec urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 sh -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8081; printf \"GET /health HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\" >&3; sleep 1; cat <&3' 2>/dev/null | head -20 | tail -3", "summary": "Check cms exit cause and backend health"}

summary: Check cms exit cause and backend health
